The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] defeated the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in a brief, one-sided '''war''' roughly a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The victorious Republic forcibly admitted the eleven [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]] along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and established the new [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Although the [[Greater Javin/Legends|region]] enjoyed a resulting economic boom as commerce developed over the following [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the Mugaari resented [[Human/Legends|humans]] for their encroachment.

==Prelude==
A [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] before the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] extended as far as the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Javin]] at the edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> which divided the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from what was then considered to be [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Atlas" /> This imperfectly surveyed frontier region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] attracted only [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and the bravest of [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Javin itself belonged to [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]], a semi-independent collection of eleven worlds ruled for millennia by the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Mugaari]], who were wary of the Republic.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

The region's traders journeyed across the Mid Rim frontier to the outer reaches of Mugaari Space and sometimes beyond in order to make contact with worlds controlled by two other relatively nearby [[Alien/Legends|alien]] civilizations, the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] and [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]]. These natives had traded sporadically with the Republic for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]],<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> but their respective [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] and [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] could only be reached by taking painfully slow detours around the region's sprawling [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]]<ref name="Atlas" /> and by surrendering major profit shares to the Mugaari.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==The war==
The Republic defeated the Mugaari in a brief, one-sided war,<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> forcibly annexing the eleven member worlds of Mugaari Space<ref name="Atlas" /> as Republic [[Cartographer/Legends|cartographers]] established the sprawling new [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Still, despite the efforts of countless [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers, a shorter route to Lutrillia and Nothoiin would remain elusive for centuries.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Aftermath==
Republic seizure of regional power over the former holdings of Mugaari Space allowed for many newly settled worlds along the Corellian Trade Spine, including [[Mexeluine/Legends|Mexeluine]], [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], [[Indellian]], [[Bendeluum/Legends|Bendeluum]], [[Ione/Legends|Ione]], [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]], [[Orn Kios/Legends|Orn Kios]], and [[Isde Naha/Legends|Isde Nada]]. Launching from Gerrenthum, scout [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] eventually succeeded in blazing new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|star lanes]] straight through the Twin Nebulae to connect the Trade Spine with Lutrillia and Nothoiin. Figg's miraculous achievement turned the [[Greater Javin/Legends|collective region]] into an economic powerhouse.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Following their [[Species/Legends|species']] defeat at the hands of the Republic, most Mugaari left the planet Javin, formerly the most populous Mugaari world after [[Mugaar/Legends|Mugaar]] itself.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> The Mugaari resented [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as invaders and occupiers, and contemned Lutrillians and Nothoiin as collaborators.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Galactic Republic&ndash;Mugaari war was established in "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
